title: Sex and the City: Demographics, Spatial Sorting, and the Marriage Market
title_zh: 城市与性：人口结构、空间分选与婚姻市场
authors: Min Fang, Zibin Huang, Yushi Wang, Yu (Alan) Yang
abstract: We study how the interaction between demographic changes and spatial sorting affects marriage matching across space. Using data from China, we first present stylized facts on the diverging spatial distribution of singlehood characterized by a high singles rate for females (males) in more (less) developed cities. We then build a quantitative spatial equilibrium model. It reveals that more highly educated women sort into the service sector in more developed cities than men. With persistent social norms of hypergamy, this results in more failed marriage matches for females (males) in more (less) developed cities, thereby lowering the national marriage rate.
abstract_zh: 本文研究人口结构变化与空间分选之间的相互作用如何影响跨区域的婚姻匹配。利用中国数据，我们首先呈现了单身现象空间分布分化的典型事实：在较发达城市，女性单身率较高；而在欠发达城市，男性单身率较高。随后，我们构建了一个定量空间均衡模型。模型揭示，相较于男性，更多高学历女性倾向于在较发达城市的服务部门集聚。在持续存在的“上嫁”社会规范下，这导致较发达城市中女性婚姻匹配失败率上升，而欠发达城市中男性婚姻匹配失败率上升，进而降低了全国婚姻率。

title: DP21780 Life After Divorce: Effects of Joint Custody on Parents and Children
title_zh: DP21780 离婚后的生活：共同监护对父母与子女的影响
authors: Stella Canessa, Gordon Dahl, Anna Hasselqvist, Costas Meghir, Susan Niknami 等
official: 官方在线 2026-07-23 · 来源：出版社网页
abstract: Divorce reshapes family life, yet little is known about one of its most consequential features: the allocation of child custody. We study the impact of joint versus sole custody on both parents and children using rich administrative data from Sweden linked to over 25 years of newly-collected court custody rulings. To address selection concerns, we exploit random assignment of custody disputes to judges who differ sharply in their propensity to grant joint custody. For fathers, joint custody substantially raises earnings and improves mental health, consistent with sustained paternal involvement enhancing labor market attachment and psychological well-being. In contrast, there are no measurable labor market or mental health effects for mothers. Turning to children, joint custody increases standardized test scores and school quality without affecting mental health outcomes. Joint custody increases fathers’ chances of remarriage, keeps separated parents in closer geographic proximity, and has no effect on intimate partner violence allegations against either partner. These findings inform longstanding debates over the role of child custody in shaping post-divorce family life.
abstract_zh: 离婚重塑了家庭生活，然而其最具深远影响的特征之一——子女监护权的分配——却鲜为人知。我们利用瑞典超过25年新收集的法院监护权裁决数据，结合丰富的行政记录，研究了共同监护与单独监护对父母及子女的影响。为应对选择偏差问题，我们利用监护权争议案件随机分配给法官的机制，这些法官在授予共同监护权的倾向性上存在显著差异。对父亲而言，共同监护显著提高了其收入并改善了心理健康，这与持续的父亲参与增强劳动力市场依附性和心理幸福感的结果一致。相比之下，母亲在劳动力市场或心理健康方面未观察到可测量的影响。就子女而言，共同监护提高了标准化考试成绩和学校质量，但未影响心理健康结果。共同监护增加了父亲再婚的可能性，使分居父母保持更近的地理距离，且未对任何一方的亲密伴侣暴力指控产生影响。这些发现为关于监护权如何塑造离婚后家庭生活的长期争论提供了依据。

title: Striking While the Iron Is Cold: Fragility after a Surge of Lumpy Investments,
title_zh: 趁热打铁：大宗投资激增后的脆弱性
source: Journal of the European Economic Association
abstract: This paper studies how large firms’ synchronized lumpy investments endogenously shape an economy’s fragility to negative TFP shocks. I develop a heterogeneous-firm real business cycle model that matches the empirical interest rate elasticities of investment for both large and small firms. In the model, large firms’ lumpy investments become persistently synchronized due to their low sensitivity to general equilibrium effects, generating investment surges. Following these surges, TFP-induced recessions are particularly severe, and the semi-elasticity of aggregate investment drops significantly, consistent with the data.
abstract_zh: 摘要 本文研究大型企业同步化的大额投资如何内生地塑造经济对负向全要素生产率冲击的脆弱性。我构建了一个异质性企业真实商业周期模型，该模型能够匹配大型企业与小型企业投资对利率的实证弹性。在模型中，大型企业的大额投资因对一般均衡效应敏感度较低而持续同步化，从而引发投资激增。这些激增之后，全要素生产率冲击引发的衰退尤为严重，且总体投资的半弹性显著下降，这与数据表现一致。

title: The perceived inflation wedge: Why households experience inflation differently from official statistics
title_zh: 感知通胀差距：为何家庭对通胀的感受与官方统计不同
abstract: Households often report inflation perceptions and expectations that differ markedly from official measures. This column proposes a new measure of perceived inflation, which uses disaggregated inflation data with indicators for household attention to capture the prices that people actually notice. The difference between perceived and official inflation varies over time and becomes particularly pronounced during periods of economic stress. Heightened attention to inflation is persistent and can remain elevated even after official inflation measures improve. As central banks recognise the importance of household beliefs for macroeconomic outcomes, it becomes important to also understand the gap between measured and perceived inflation.
abstract_zh: 家庭通常报告的通货膨胀感知和预期与官方指标存在显著差异。本文提出了一种新的感知通胀衡量方法，该方法利用分类通胀数据及家庭关注度指标，以捕捉人们实际注意到的价格变化。感知通胀与官方通胀之间的差异随时间推移而变化，在经济压力时期尤为显著。对通胀的高度关注具有持续性，即使在官方通胀指标改善后仍可能保持高位。随着央行认识到家庭信念对宏观经济结果的重要性，理解衡量通胀与感知通胀之间的差距也变得至关重要。

title: Local Determinacy in Incomplete-Markets Models
title_zh: 不完全市场模型中的局部确定性
source: Journal of Economic Dynamics and Control
abstract: This paper proposes the first methodology for assessing local determinacy in incomplete-markets models. My simple determinacy criterion yields theoretical results and can be verified numerically. It merely requires calculating aggregate marginal propensities to consume (MPC) and aggregate elasticities of asset demand. I find that the policy rules ensuring determinacy can be quite different in incomplete as opposed to complete-markets models. My methodology can thus avoid the current (flawed) practice of referring to complete markets results to assess determinacy in incomplete markets models. The main findings are: If bonds are nominal, the economy is always determinate for a constant nominal interest rate or for price level targeting if prices are sufficiently rigid. The model is indeterminate if fiscal policy is too expansionary, requiring a monetary policy response to reestablish determinacy. If bonds are real, whether or not the Taylor principle induces determinacy depends non-linearly on MPCs, the degree of price rigidities and whether interest rates respond to output. I also find the determinacy properties of active and passive fiscal rules (Leeper, 1991) to be different in incomplete and complete markets models. I explain the shortcomings in Kaplan et al. (2023), which are the reason for their different and thus invalid findings.

title: GLP-1–Induced Weight Loss and the Female Obesity Penalty
title_zh: GLP-1诱导的体重减轻与女性肥胖惩罚
official: 官方在线 2026-06-29 · 来源：出版社网页
abstract: GLP-1 medications generate large weight loss and may also alter social and economic outcomes. Using the Understanding America Study, I compare women starting GLP-1s for weight loss with matched women who would like to start a GLP-1 but have not. Single women’s marriage/cohabitation rates rise by 29 percentage points and employment among baseline non-employed women rises 27 percentage points after six or more quarters. Existing partnerships do not dissolve, and already-employed women show no upward job mobility. The pattern suggests that part of the female obesity penalty operates at new-match formation rather than only through health or incumbent productivity.
abstract_zh: GLP-1药物能显著减轻体重，并可能改变社会与经济结果。利用《理解美国研究》数据，我将因减重而开始使用GLP-1的女性与匹配的、有意愿但尚未使用GLP-1的女性进行比较。在六个季度或更长时间后，单身女性的婚姻/同居率上升29个百分点，基线未就业女性的就业率上升27个百分点。现有伴侣关系并未瓦解，而已就业女性未表现出向上职业流动性。这一模式表明，女性肥胖惩罚的部分作用机制在于新匹配关系的形成，而非仅通过健康或现有生产力途径实现。

title: School feeding, maternal empowerment, and household consumption
title_zh: 学校供餐、女性赋权与家庭消费
authors: Guanfu Fang, Tianyuan Luo, Benyu Qian
abstract: This paper examines the causal effects of a school feeding program on maternal empowerment and household consumption in rural China. Exploiting the staggered implementation of the Student Nutrition Improvement Program, we find that the program significantly reduces maternal time spent on housework, improves maternal labor market performance, and enhances maternal decision‐making power within nuclear households. The augmented bargaining power translates into shifts in household consumption toward female‐prioritized goods, including more nutritious foods, clothing, and housework‐related appliances. However, these positive effects on maternal empowerment are diminished in multigenerational families, where grandparents can assist with childcare responsibilities.
abstract_zh: 本文考察了学校供餐计划对中国农村地区女性赋权及家庭消费的因果效应。利用学生营养改善计划的分阶段实施，我们发现该计划显著减少了母亲的家务劳动时间，改善了母亲在劳动力市场的表现，并增强了母亲在核心家庭中的决策权。这种议价能力的提升促使家庭消费转向女性优先商品，包括更营养的食品、衣物及家务相关电器。然而，在多代同堂的家庭中，由于祖父母可协助承担育儿责任，这些对女性赋权的积极影响有所减弱。

title: Long-Term Health and Human Capital Effects of Universal Health Care and Mass Literacy: Evidence from Cuba
title_zh: 全民医保与大规模扫盲的长期健康及人力资本效应：来自古巴的证据
official: 官方在线 2026-06-15 · 来源：文章页面
abstract: We estimate long-run effects of Cuba's 1961 National Health Service and contemporaneous National Literacy Campaign using synthetic-control methods on newly assembled series for 21 former European colonies in the Americas, 1900--2022. Relative to synthetic Cuba, infant mortality falls 15--29 percent and average years of schooling rise 1.5--2 years; both effects are large, persistent, and robust to augmented SCM, synthetic difference-in-differences, interactive fixed effects, and matrix completion. Life-expectancy gains attenuate after 1990, consistent with the post-Soviet Special Period, suggesting that bundled health and literacy reforms permanently raise early-life survival and human capital, with smaller and less robust effects on adult longevity.
abstract_zh: 我们利用合成控制法，基于新编制的1900—2022年美洲21个前欧洲殖民地的序列数据，估算了古巴1961年国家卫生服务与同期全国扫盲运动的长期效应。与合成古巴相比，婴儿死亡率下降15%—29%，平均受教育年限增加1.5—2年；这两个效应均显著、持久，并在增强型合成控制法、合成双重差分法、交互固定效应模型及矩阵补全方法中保持稳健。预期寿命的改善在1990年后有所减弱，这与后苏联时期的“特殊时期”相一致，表明捆绑式的卫生与扫盲改革永久性地提高了早期生存率与人力资本，但对成人寿命的影响较小且稳健性较弱。

title: Unpacking Aggregate Welfare in a Spatial Economy
title_zh: 空间经济中的总福利解构
authors: Eric Donald, Masao Fukui, Yuhei Miyauchi
abstract: How do regional productivity shocks or transportation infrastructure improvements affect aggregate welfare? In a general class of spatial equilibrium models, we provide a formula for aggregate welfare changes, decomposed into terms associated with (i) technology [Fogel (1964), Railroads and American Economic Growth (Baltimore: Johns Hopkins Press), Hulten (1978) “Growth Accounting with Intermediate Inputs”, The Review of Economic Studies, 45, 511–518], (ii) spatial dispersion of marginal utility, (iii) fiscal externalities, (iv) technological externalities, and (v) redistribution. We further use this decomposition to derive a general formula for optimal spatial transfers and show that, whenever optimal transfers are in place, the technology term alone captures the aggregate welfare effects of technological shocks. We apply our framework to study welfare gains from improving the US highway network. We find that changes in the spatial dispersion of marginal utility are as important as technological externalities in accounting for the deviations from the Fogel-Hulten benchmark to assess welfare gains.
abstract_zh: 区域生产率冲击或交通基础设施改善如何影响总体福利？在一类通用的空间均衡模型中，我们推导出总体福利变化的分解公式，该公式包含以下组成部分：(i) 技术效应 [Fogel (1964), 《铁路与美国经济增长》(巴尔的摩：约翰·霍普金斯出版社)；Hulten (1978)《中间投入的增长核算》，《经济研究评论》，第45卷，511–518页]；(ii) 边际效用的空间分散程度；(iii) 财政外部性；(iv) 技术外部性；以及(v) 再分配效应。我们进一步利用该分解推导出最优空间转移支付的一般公式，并证明当最优转移支付机制存在时，仅技术效应项即可完全捕捉技术冲击对总体福利的影响。我们将该分析框架应用于评估美国高速公路网络改善带来的福利收益，发现边际效用空间分散程度的变化与技术外部性在解释福利收益偏离Fogel-Hulten基准时具有同等重要性。
